items.caption: This oracle-script-style form is labeled 服, but its use and graphic interpretation remain uncertain. One proposed account treats 服 as a later phonosemantic form associated with 𠬝; this redraw alone does not establish that history.
items.alt: A black, irregular glyph with a low, broad left section and taller branching strokes on the right, on a white field.
items.selection_reason: It supplies a candidate early form relevant to the proposed relationship between 服 and 𠬝. Its reading and component history are not settled by the image.

items.caption: This bronze-script-style redraw labeled 服 has a dense left section beside a taller, branching right section. The form is relevant to proposed analyses connecting 服 with 𠬝, but does not settle whether the right-side shape reflects 凡, 舟, or a tray-like form.
items.alt: A black glyph with a compact, multi-opening left section and a larger branching right section, on a white field.
items.selection_reason: It adds a visibly distinct bronze-style candidate for the disputed graphic analysis; the specific date and identity of its components remain uncertain.

limitations.text: These images are modern redraws rather than photographs of inscribed artifacts. The oracle-style file has only an approximate period label, and the bronze-style file does not establish a precise date or settle the identity of the disputed component.

The relationship between 服 and 𠬝 is a proposed graph history; competing tray/service interpretations remain unresolved. The images alone cannot establish the meaning or historical sequence of these forms.
